question: The latest gated review set: every action x direction on the current rig (R), motion (M), pixel chain (P) and face layer (F).

Full table: exp/.../release/out/20261029_d240736/GATES.md
verdict: The round-7 head comes out mixed-to-better against the r4 head. - B wins on structure: the face follows the head (A 5 -> B 8, both critics), bangs are full (5 -> 8-9; bangs gate 48/48, was 28/48), and head position improves (anim 5 -> 7). - B loses on 1x face readability (7 -> 4): the fringe sits on the eyes so they become dark slits; blush and mouth vanish at 1x; the profile skin is a flat peach blob; white speck pixels show on the hair in N/NE/NW. - On-model and expressive are about even. - Other gates: limbs 44/48 (was 35), posture 2/2 + 2/2 + 6/6 (E head-forward +1.8..+2.6 px), boil 13/48, shade_swap 0/48, GIF 48/48. - The critics still see a slight chest arch in the idle E/W look beat (f05-f08) and a hurt that reads as an arm wave. - AD's advice: keep the B geometry and fix the feature readability.
